ideas.title: Renewal board
ideas.why: Every contract ending in the next 30 days on one board, with batch renew or end. Dozens fall due the same weeks at a multi-branch store.

ideas.title: Privacy and terms pack
ideas.why: Privacy notice, terms, and export or delete one end customer's data on request. It's legally required, and buyers will ask.

ideas.title: Late-payer flag
ideas.why: Mark customers who usually pay late and show it when a new quote opens, so the shop can ask for an advance.

ideas.title: Taste map
ideas.why: Map everything watched by country, decade and genre, and point out blind spots with three starter picks.

ideas.title: Affiliate rent/buy links
ideas.why: Where to rent or buy each title, through free affiliate programs. A first zero-cost revenue stream.

ideas.title: What-if sandbox
ideas.why: Simulate a big decision on a household copy and see the next 6 to 12 quincenas next to the real ones, using the existing forecast.

ideas.title: Local fallback lane for builds
ideas.why: When cloud agent usage runs out, Ready tickets go to the local runner with a token cap, so night work keeps moving at $0.
